name: PGHOST_ST_INIT
meaning: SetState 0: disables the three camera restrictions (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_STAND
meaning: SetState 1: anim STAND; Update: faces the Wolf (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_AT_POST
meaning: SetState 2: anim STAND2; Update: faces the Wolf (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_APPEAR
meaning: SetState 3: camera restrictions on, anim APPEAR; Update: -> 6 or 8 (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_LIFT_WOLF
meaning: SetState 4: anim HOO, MSG_WOLF_STRIP, msg 0x416; Update: lifts the Wolf (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_CARRY_WOLF
meaning: SetState 5: anim WALK, msg 0x416 and MSG_SWITCH_ON to the gate (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_LIFT_SHEEP
meaning: SetState 6: anim HOO at the sheep (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_TAKE_COSTUME
meaning: SetState 8: anim HOO, MSG_WOLF_STRIP and MSG_WOLF_TAKE_ITEM_CLASS 0x7d (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_RESET_POSTS
meaning: Update 9: msg 0x4500 to all four ghosts, -> 10 (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_PRAY
meaning: SetState 10: anim PRAISE for prayDurMs; Update: watches for the Wolf (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_GO_TO_POST
meaning: SetState 11: anim STAND2; Update: -> 2 at the post (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_CHASE
meaning: SetState 12: anim WALK toward the target (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_GRAB
meaning: SetState 13: anim KILL, halo JUMP1; Update: grabs the target (msg 0xe) (inferred)

name: PGHOST_ST_RETURN
meaning: SetState 14: anim WALK, checkpoint msg 0x1080; Update: walks home (inferred)
